name: San Francisco Human Services Agency
description: The city and county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for San Francisco residents.
fullDescription: The city and county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for San Francisco residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- County Adult Assistance Programs (CAAP) for adults without children
- In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) intake
howToGetIt: Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call to find the nearest office and start an application by phone.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, County Adult Assistance, benefits office, apply, San Francisco, human services agency, HSA
